content:
Dear all,

@Nirvana Coppola and I will be leading a project on "Formalizing local-to-global results in Lean" at the Women in Numbers 7 (WIN 7) workshop.

WIN 7 will be held at Banff International Research Station in Banff, Canada from June 14 - 18, 2026. The WIN 7 workshop is primarily focused on collaborative research projects composed of 2 leaders and 2-4 participants. Participant applications are open to all who wish to apply.

The application form is available on the WIN 7 website and also can be accessed here. Applicants will answer questions about their mathematical background, research interests, project preferences (project titles, leaders, and descriptions are linked within the application), and how their interest and participation fits with the goals of the WIN network. Graduate student applicants are asked to have their advisor submit a brief letter of reference by email.

The application deadline is December 8, 2025.

Please advertise to those in your network who you think may be interested!

María Inés and Nirvana
